_description: Cash growth bypass holds even when stockAllocation is mis-set on the cash account — regression guard for the `account.type === 'cash'` branch taking priority over allocation lookup.
_rationale: $100k cash with stockAllocation 0.6 (wrong — cash accounts should always grow yield-only). Big stock return (50%) and bond return (10%). If the growth loop incorrectly multiplied cash by 0.6×1.5 + 0.4×1.1 = 1.34, year 1 cash would balloon to $134k pre-spending → $114k after $20k spending. The bypass requires cash to grow ONLY by cashYieldRate (4%) → 100k × 1.04 = $104k → $84k after spending. Test asserts $84k.
name: Cash Growth Bypass Regression
